lines.say: ChatGPT will do your problem sheet. It won't sit your exam.
So the night before, what actually helps? A, reading the worked solution. B, explaining the method from a blank page.
B. Testing yourself beats rereading. It's called the testing effect.
Offload makes you explain the method in your own words, then gives you exam-style questions on your own module notes.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
